monitoring.settings.dsn: Your own error tracker (GlitchTip or Sentry DSN)
monitoring.settings.dsnInvalid: Not a DSN: it looks like https://<key>@host/<project number>.
monitoring.settings.dsnNote: Optional. Reports go there instead of the build's tracker. Leave it empty to use the build's, if it has one. The site's security policy must allow the host.
monitoring.settings.errorsNote: The error's class name and where in the code it happened. No message, note text, titles, paths, page address or IP address. Secrets and personal details are removed too.
monitoring.settings.noTracker: No error tracker is set, so nothing is sent whatever the switches say.
monitoring.settings.performanceNote: Once per session: how many page loads were good, needs improvement or poor for each web vital. No timings, no page address.
monitoring.settings.title: Error and performance reports
monitoring.settings.tracker: Reports go to {host}, and only with a switch below turned on.
